Get one-time cleanup
Get the guidance you need to grow your business confidently. QuickBooks-certified bookkeepers coach you on books, taxes, and cash flow, with insights to keep you on track.
EXPERT FULL SERVICE BOOKKEEPING
Ongoing bookkeeping and insights
Focus on your business with guaranteed accurate books. A dedicated QuickBooks-certified bookkeeper manages your books, sends reports, and shares insights to help you make smarter financial decisions.
Just need a one-time books cleanup?
Intuit Expert Cleanup helps you find every deduction, stay compliant, and save days of internal tax prep. They’ll clean your books to give you guaranteed accuracy and avoid costly mistakes.
“The Intuit Expert bookkeepers save me time and give me peace of mind to be able to get back to what I really started this business for.”
Does QuickBooks offer bookkeeping services?

Yes! Intuit Expert offers online bookkeeping services that connect small businesses with real bookkeeping experts. Depending on the service you choose, a bookkeeper can give you guidance or take the lead on your bookkeeping.
What is the difference between Expert Assisted and Expert Full Service Bookkeeping?

Expert Assisted is a monthly subscription service offering ongoing guidance on how to manage your books. You get access to bookkeeping experts who can answer your questions on a variety of bookkeeping subjects and provide tax resource support to help you understand your books. With Expert Assisted, you’ll still be managing your own books.

With Expert Full Service Bookkeeping, you get all the benefits included in Expert Assisted, plus an initial cleanup of your books. Then we pair you with a dedicated bookkeeper who will manage your monthly books for you on an ongoing basis, so you can focus on your business.

Tax preparation or filing services are not included in either Expert Assisted or Expert Full Service Bookkeeping, but are available to be purchased separately via Intuit Expert Assisted Business Tax, powered by TurboTax.**

The bookkeepers in Intuit Expert Assisted and Intuit Full Service Bookkeeping can also provide financial and business coaching, and answer questions on topics like categorization and automation, and guidance on report insights to manage and grow your business. Examples of those questions could be:
When is the business tax filing deadline for my business entity?
How do I prepare a 1099 for my contractor?

With Expert Assisted, bookkeeping experts are available to give you guidance and answer questions you have on bookkeeping topics like categorization, automation, reconciliation, reporting, and workflow management. In addition, they are available to coach you on common business, payroll, sales and 1099 tax topics like regulations, deadlines, deductions, and payments. You can request a callback anytime when you need a little extra help.

Bookkeeping experts are available Monday-Friday 6AM - 6PM PT. Some bookkeeping services may not be included and will be determined by your bookkeeping experts. Your bookkeeping experts will provide help based on the information you provide. Expert Assisted bookkeeping expert will not work in your books, and cannot give tax advice specific to your business, or prepare or file taxes for you.
What’s included in Expert Full Service Bookkeeping?
Expert Full Service Bookkeeping includes two phases: cleanup and ongoing bookkeeping.

In the cleanup/setup phase, your dedicated bookkeeper helps you set up your chart of accounts, connects your banks, and teaches you the basics of QuickBooks. If you have information in QuickBooks already, your bookkeeper will help clean it up in the first month of service.
As part of ongoing bookkeeping, your dedicated bookkeeper categorizes your transactions and reconciles your accounts each month.
Your bookkeeper can close your books and prepare a trial balance. They can also PDF copies of key financial reports including your profit and loss statement and balance sheet.
In addition, Expert Full Service Bookkeeping gives you all the benefits included in Expert Assisted. These benefits include:
Intuit Full Service bookkeeping experts cannot give tax advice specific to your business, or prepare or file taxes for you.

QuickBooks Expert Assisted and QuickBooks Expert Full-Service Bookkeeping give you access to bookkeepers, who are available to provide resource support so you can make smarter decisions with your books, business tax, payroll tax, sales tax and 1099 filings. Specifically, they can provide general information to common tax questions related to regulations, deadlines, deductions, business entity, business payment options, payroll tax filing, payroll tax requirements, 1099s, and sales tax. However, bookkeepers will not assist with any preparation of your federal and/or state tax returns and/or answer any tax preparation related questions to your specific business situation.

QuickBooks Expert Tax, powered by TurboTax, is comprised of: Full-Service Tax with access to a business tax expert who will do your taxes for you from start to finish; and Assisted Tax with access to tax experts who will help you do your own taxes and conduct a final review before you file. Both QuickBooks Expert Full-Service Tax and QuickBooks Expert Assisted Tax are “powered by TurboTax” tax preparation services and each require an active QuickBooks Online subscription. Full-Service Tax also provides an optional, one-time bookkeeping cleanup service for businesses provided by a QuickBooks bookkeeper.
What tax resource support can I get in Expert Assisted and Expert Full Service Bookkeeping?
Our bookkeepers experts can provide general information and relevant resources to help you find answers to a variety of common tax topics for:
Payroll tax
Payroll tax payments
Payroll tax filing
Managing payroll tax requirements
Sales tax
General education of sales tax function
Sales tax features and setup within QuickBooks
Determining when sales tax applies
How to find sales tax rates
Sales tax regulations and deadlines
General education of 1099s
How 1099s work in QuickBooks
How to prepare, edit, file, and correct 1099s
1099 regulations and deadlines
Bookkeeping experts cannot give tax advice specific to your business, prepare, or file taxes for you.
What’s not included in Expert Assisted or Expert Full Service Bookkeeping?
Our bookkeeping experts will not be able to give you guidance on the following topics:
Tax advice, tax preparation and tax compliance, including but not limited to compliance and filings for sales tax, state tax, local tax, and federal tax returns.
Can my bookkeeper prepare and file taxes?
Our bookkeepers can’t prepare or file your taxes for you as part of your Intuit Experts service – even if they’re a credentialed CPA.
